description.value: ChiuChow Seafood Restaurant is a Chiu Chow (Teochew)-style Chinese restaurant specializing in dim sum and seafood, situated on the second floor of a building near Vancouver General Hospital in the Cambie corridor. The menu spans handmade dumplings, fresh seafood congee, and traditional slow-marinated meats including goose and duck — hallmarks of the Chiu Chow culinary tradition rarely found outside of specialist restaurants. Online table booking and ordering are available through the restaurant's dedicated ordering platform.
